summary: Preinstall hook downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated sibling payload
details: The package's npm preinstall hook runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases into a temporary directory, marks it executable, and then uses that downloaded runtime to execute a sibling file math_init.js on the installer's machine. setup.mjs is minified with _0xXXXX-style identifier obfuscation. math_init.js is a 727KB file with string-array rotation obfuscation (function WV8StW shifting an array of opaque constants) and is not referenced from the package's declared main entry (lib/component.js) or any require/import path — it is invoked only by the preinstall dropper via the alien runtime. The package advertises itself as a Vue UI list input component and has no functional need for the Bun runtime or a math_init payload. Using a freshly-downloaded non-Node runtime to execute obfuscated code at install time evades Node-based scanning and runs on the installer's host as a side effect of npm install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
